reuse_for_next_paper: Find the first missing causal link and predeclare the smallest experiment that could disprove the proposed explanation.
Inspect the actual source and runtime profile early; historical success establishes a possible route, not interchangeable source,checkpoint,token stream or absolute timing.
Keep measured outcome, source capability, causal hypothesis and environmental blocker in separate fields.
Use evidence producer semantics to decide what a missing log means; instrumentation counts are not universal mechanism invariants.
Choose an oracle for the actual mathematical/task claim. C1/GDN, four workers,local-first logging,physical0-3,port/cap and tolerances are this case, not requirements for every paper.
